requirement.evidence: It shall be unlawful for a landlord to use a coordinated pricing algorithm described in subsection A when setting rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley.
requirement.note: Prohibition on use and sale, the 90-day competitor data definition, and tenant remedies (injunctive relief, damages, penalties up to $1,000, attorney's fees) are all in the text. The City Attorney's separate enforcement power is omitted, but the card does not say otherwise.

key_value.evidence: Each separate month that a violation exists or continues, and each separate residential dwelling unit for which the landlord used the coordinated pricing algorithm, shall constitute a separate and distinct violation.
key_value.note: The $1,000 per violation cap appears in 13.63.040(A) and (B).
